subject: bin/actl entry + root rule: AC_ROOT/AC_CODE_ROOT resolution replaces every $0 walk; harness runs A's scripts from AC_HOME against a sandbox root
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C1-C3, section 1, section 8 first bullet, follow-up row 1. Main's rulings (D-072): the entry is named actl (not ac; macOS ships /usr/sbin/ac), file bin/actl. (1) bin/actl is a POSIX sh dispatcher: AC_HOME = realpath of its own dir/..; parses -C <dir>; resolves AC_ROOT in this order with no silent fallback: AC_ROOT env, -C, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, main root of cwd's git tree (parent of git rev-parse --git-common-dir, so a worktree yields the main repo), else rc 2 with one stderr line containing 'not inside a project' and '-C'. After resolution AC_ROOT/board/config.json must exist else rc 2 naming 'actl init'. It exports AC_HOME AC_ROOT AC_CONTROL_DIR=$AC_HOME/scripts and execs the mapped script per the section 1 table (land gate apply review auto-fix ticket event inbox status memory rules repo-map verify verify-case board session heartbeat version; test/hooks/doctor/migrate/init rows are wired by later tickets and until then print 'not landed yet' rc 2). Unknown command: rc 2 and the table on stderr. 'actl version' works outside any project (rc 0) and prints one labelled line each: AC_HOME=<path>, ac_sha=<HEAD of AC_HOME or unknown when AC_HOME is not a git tree>, AC_ROOT=<path or (none)>, AC_CODE_ROOT=<path or (none)>. The config_version check (row 2) is NOT in this ticket; leave a clearly marked hook point. (2) The $0 walk is gone: delete the _ac_root() blocks in apply.sh review.sh auto-fix.sh heartbeat.sh session-hook.sh consolidate-memory.sh new-session.sh (two) and the dirname "$0")/.. ROOT lines in gate.sh:114 and land.sh:73. Every script takes ROOT=AC_ROOT when set, else the cwd rule (one shared implementation, not nine copies), else exits 2 with the same 'not inside a project' line; session-hook.sh uses CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR when AC_ROOT is unset. event.repo_root() keeps AC_ROOT, falls back to the cwd rule, never to __file__, and raises SystemExit(2) with that line when neither applies; looks_like_a_copy() keeps working. AC_CONTROL_DIR default stays dirname $0 (scripts live in A's clone). (3) Code root AC_CODE_ROOT (tree under test): env, else cwd's git --show-toplevel. gate.sh ROOT, verify.py _find_root (no __file__), verify-case.py (exports AC_CODE_ROOT=<copy> for each copy it runs) use it. (4) Dogfood gate rule (C3): land.sh runs the full gate from $WT/scripts/gate.sh only when realpath main root == realpath AC_HOME; every other project gets $AC_HOME/scripts/gate.sh. (5) ac_sha: session.start and gate.start/pass/fail events gain --kv ac_sha=<HEAD of AC_HOME or unknown>; no new status.json field. (6) Harness (section 8 first bullet): tests/control_harness.py make_repo stops copying SCRIPT_FILES and board.py into the sandbox; one ac_env() helper sets AC_HOME (A's root, or AC_TEST_SCRIPTS' parent for mutation runs), AC_ROOT=<sandbox>, cwd=sandbox; run_py/run_sh resolve script paths against AC_HOME; gate_stub becomes a per-test <home>/ac-home copy of A's scripts with gate.sh replaced, and AC_HOME points there, so 'was the gate called' stays a marker file. Existing cases that pinned the walk are rewritten to the new contract (listed in outline). Also add gate.sh map rows for bin/actl and tests/control_harness.py's new helper so the gate still guards them (map() itself is deleted in row 3b).
acceptance: A1 (tests/test_actl.py, harness sandbox): V1 via 'sh $AC_HOME/bin/actl version' and one real command. (a) cwd = a sandbox ticket worktree (git worktree add under worktree_dir) -> AC_ROOT line == realpath(sandbox), AC_CODE_ROOT line == realpath(worktree), and 'actl ticket list --open' there lists the sandbox ticket's subject (string the test wrote). (b) cwd = an empty tmp dir outside any git tree, no -C, no AC_ROOT: 'actl ticket list --open' rc 2, stderr contains 'not inside a project' and '-C'; the tmp dir and A's own tickets/ listing are unchanged (sorted listing before == after). (c) cwd in sandbox but -C <other sandbox> -> AC_ROOT == the -C sandbox. (d) cwd in sandbox and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<other sandbox> -> AC_ROOT == the env one. (e) 'actl nonsense' rc 2 and stderr contains 'land', 'gate', 'ticket', 'version'. Expected paths come from the test's own tempdirs (realpath), never from actl output.

A2 static + repo_root (tests/test_actl.py): grep -c '_ac_root' over scripts/*.sh = 0; grep -c 'dirname "$0")/..' over scripts/*.sh excluding scripts/gate.example.sh and scripts/sync-to-project.sh (both retired by row 6; sync-to-project.sh is in hard_block.paths so this ticket cannot edit it, and its line 34 HERE is A's own root, i.e. AC_HOME semantics, not a project root) = 0; grep -c '__file__' scripts/verify.py = 0 in root resolution (the test asserts _find_root's source has no __file__). Behaviour: 'python3 $AC_HOME/scripts/event.py emit ticket.attempt.start --ticket 1' run with cwd = tmp dir outside any git tree and AC_ROOT unset -> rc 2, stderr contains 'not inside a project'; A's board/events.jsonl (if present) byte-identical before/after and no events.jsonl created under the tmp dir. Existing tests/test_event.py cases stay green.

A3 V3 dogfood rule (tests/test_land.py or tests/test_actl.py, harness, gate_stub marker): (a) default sandbox (AC_HOME = per-test copy of A's scripts with the stub gate): 'land.sh <ticket>' leaves the stub's marker file whose content names $AC_HOME/scripts/gate.sh (the stub writes its own $0), and the sandbox worktree has no scripts/gate.sh. (b) dogfood sandbox: copy the per-test ac-home scripts into <sandbox>/scripts, commit, set AC_HOME=<sandbox>; the ticket branch replaces scripts/gate.sh with a stub writing 'WT-GATE' -> after land the marker says WT-GATE, i.e. the worktree's gate ran. Mutation (not measured by opener): land.sh always picks $AC_HOME -> (b) red.

A4 pinned old behaviour rewritten and suites green: tests/test_new_session.py test_a7_without_ac_root_it_walks_up_to_the_config becomes 'cwd inside the sandbox, AC_ROOT unset -> the sandbox ticket subject is on the page' and the module no longer references scripts/control/; tests/test_verify_runner.py test_ac_root_elsewhere_still_runs_the_cases_beside_this_file becomes 'AC_CODE_ROOT=<tmp copy> runs the copy's red case while AC_ROOT=HERE' (same red string, same assertion); tests/test_auto_fix.py docstring at ~1483 no longer says _ac_root. These modules are green: test_event test_new_session test_verify_runner test_gate test_land test_session_hook test_heartbeat test_apply test_review test_auto_fix test_consolidate_memory test_board (Ran counts reported verbatim).

A5 ac_sha kv (tests/test_new_session.py + tests/test_gate.py): with AC_HOME = A's real root, 'new-session.sh main fable' in the sandbox emits session.start with kv ac_sha == output of 'git -C <A root> rev-parse HEAD' computed by the test; 'gate.sh --base' emits gate.start with the same ac_sha; with AC_HOME = the per-test non-git copy the value is the literal 'unknown' (never empty, never missing). No status.json key is added (status.json key set before == after on the fixture run).

verify.notes: Self-contained: builds its own sandboxes and a per-test non-git copy of A (<home>/my-ac-home), passing AC_HOME/AC_ROOT explicitly; only Sandbox/make_ticket/git from tests/control_harness.py. ~3 s. A3b (dogfood: worktree gate runs when project == AC_HOME) is green on base by design (base always ran $WT gate); it guards m4. The other 7 are red on base 6d788d2 on their own assertions.

test_plan: Worker, foreground, batches < 590 s each, report Ran/OK verbatim per batch: (1) timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_actl tests.test_event tests.test_new_session tests.test_verify_runner; (2) tests.test_gate tests.test_land; (3) tests.test_session_hook tests.test_heartbeat tests.test_apply tests.test_review tests.test_consolidate_memory tests.test_board; (4) tests.test_auto_fix alone (~270 s); then the rest of the suite module by module (tests.test_sync_to_project stays as is, it is row 6's). Worker writes A1-A5 in tests/test_actl.py (new) plus the rewrites named in A4. Verifier (needs_verifier true, interface_fixed false: the harness ac_env() helper the cases need is the worker's) writes its cases in tests/test_actl_cases.py (new file, not in worker scope) after hand-in, using the new harness: at least the five V1 arms of A1 and the two arms of A3 with its own sandboxes. Mutations for the worker (not measured by opener): m1 restore one _ac_root() block -> A2 red; m2 actl ignores -C -> A1(c) red; m3 repo_root falls back to dirname(__file__) -> A2 behaviour arm red; m4 land.sh always runs $AC_HOME gate -> A3(b) red; m5 ac_sha omitted -> A5 red. Container runs as uid 0: no chmod-based unreadable-file cases (root reads them); use a missing file or invalid JSON instead. hard_block.patterns forbids the four process-signal spellings in added tests/** lines: never stop a child that way in a test; timeouts belong to subprocess.run(timeout=) inside scripts/. apply.sh / auto-fix.sh: #157 (receipt changes in those two files) is landing; take the #157 landed shape of those files as the base for their _ac_root() deletion (rebase onto main when #157 lands first; the deletion is a self-contained hunk at the top of each).
